{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZdTuew", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDEfPA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 91, "title": "Add confirmed browser-local acquisition of the bundled OSL sample files", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `e1eea17e6e2ad347b82549804c2c4c896a86206f`, follow `13 → 2 → OSL → 1 → READ 1`, or choose category `2`. Users can inspect file metadata and text previews but cannot acquire either file. `src/navigation.ts` accepts READ/LIST in these views, and `tests/services.spec.ts` explicitly rejects `DOWNLOAD 1`.

This leaves the file-acquisition purpose of OSL incomplete. It extends the deliberate preview scope of [Issue #59](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/59), rather than correcting a demonstrated regression.

## Expected outcome

Provide one complete keyboard-operated journey:

`DAISIZEN → OSL → category → inspect file → DOWNLOAD number → confirm or cancel → browser download handoff → same catalog context`

Make the existing original `NOTEINFO.TXT` and `HARU96.CSV` samples downloadable with their exact bundled contents. Preserve previews and library reading. This is a browser-local reconstruction with modern encoding; it does not authenticate historical transfer commands or protocols.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction decision

Sources inspected on 2026-10-24:

- The [author-preserved CIARI listing](https://cba.sakura.ne.jp/soft01/soft_pic.htm) records a March 17, 1996 release with separate documentation, program archive and sample files, filenames, dates and numeric size fields. Confidence is high in the preserved listing and its file distinctions. It is later HTML preservation from another SIG; it does not establish DAISIZEN navigation, original size units or transfer controls.
- The [Windows 95 client-author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) explicitly lists downloading selected OSL files separately from listing and message operations. Confidence is high in the stated capability; the release date and exact 1996 applicability remain unresolved. Client automation does not authenticate host syntax.
- The [indexed PCVAN_DL.PRO catalog entry](https://search.vector.co.jp/vsearch/vsearch.php?kanji=euc&key=PR&start=1160) describes OSL downloads and dates version 1.08 to August 15, 1996. This is supplementary, moderate-confidence target-year corroboration: search excerpts were readable, but direct opening failed. It supplies no host sequence.
- The [DAISIZEN operator memorial](https://www.chayagate.com/daisizen/index.htm) distinguishes library reading from OSL software/data categories. Confidence is high about its displayed distinctions; applying the undated configuration to 1996 remains provisional. Preserve the existing uncertainty about its mountain-forum chronology.

Focused live searches did not recover a qualifying 1996 DAISIZEN transfer/confirmation/cancellation sequence. The CROCUS description remained inaccessible; accessible author and operator sources supplied alternatives. Retain earlier failed research paths without treating them as newly authenticated evidence.

**Accepted reconstruction:** use `DOWNLOAD number` from OSL category listings and previews, followed by an explicit `Y` confirmation. Commands, confirmation wording and browser handoff are category D application conventions. Export UTF-8 without BOM, using the existing LF contents. Preserve historical encodings, protocols, transfer rates, charges and exact host prompts as unresolved questions; do not simulate them in this increment.

### Implementation and duplication evidence

- `data/pcvan/daisizen-collections.json` already contains both original files, including their filenames and final LF characters. Add no archival content or executable samples.
- `src/service-collections.ts` calculates metadata size with `TextEncoder().encode(item.body).byteLength`. The downloaded payload must match that body, excluding headings, metadata and command output.
- `src/navigation.ts` owns category/item selection and parent returns. `src/commands.ts` owns interactive confirmations and dispatch; `src/main.ts` and `src/connection.ts` connect those layers. Preserve single ownership of each submitted line.
- `src/storage/controls.ts` provides an existing Blob/object-URL download pattern. Its current helper generates backup/log filenames; OSL needs the catalog filename. Extend or reuse the pattern with the smallest suitable change, preserving existing exports.
- Live repository searches returned no open Issues or PRs. [Issue #59](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/59) established browsing/previews. [Issue #33](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/33) prohibited nonfunctional transfer actions while permitting working local operations. This increment must deliver an actual browser download handoff.
- [PR #90](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/90) and `docs/validation.md` report 317 passing checks, configured type checking/build, production mail journeys and diff review. These are Coordinator records inspected by this research graph; this graph ran no application checks.

Scope is acquisition of the two bundled OSL samples. Keep uploads, remote services, binary protocol emulation, additional catalogs, billing and storage migrations outside this change.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Advertise and implement `DOWNLOAD number` only in OSL category and preview views. Resolve numbers within the current category. Reject missing, zero, negative, fractional, unsafe, out-of-range and trailing-argument inputs without downloading or changing context. Empty categories remain useful and empty. Library and unrelated service commands retain their current scope.
- [ ] A valid request displays the selected filename, exact UTF-8 byte count and concise confirmation controls. Pin the selected file and return context for that request. `HELP` repeats its explanation; empty or invalid input cannot approve, replace the selection or reach another command owner. `Y` authorizes exactly one handoff; `N`, `BACK` and `CANCEL` cancel and restore the requesting view. `MAIN` cancels and returns to MAIN.
- [ ] Download `NOTEINFO.TXT` and `HARU96.CSV` under those exact suggested filenames. Bytes equal the corresponding bundled body encoded as UTF-8 without BOM, preserving every LF and final newline. Do not include terminal headings, metadata, prompts, JSON escaping or a generated timestamp. Neither file executes.
- [ ] Consume confirmation before invoking the browser action. Repeated or rapidly queued `Y` cannot reuse it. After success or a synchronous browser-action failure, leave useful catalog context and require a fresh request for another attempt. Clear pending approval on world invalidation/reset/restore and page reload; never persist it in backups.
- [ ] Report only that the browser download was requested or handed off. Do not claim disk-save completion, negotiated transfer, measured throughput or remote receipt. Report synchronous initiation failures without automatic retries. Do not add artificial transfer progress or modem-rate delays based on the modern payload size.
- [ ] Browsing, READ, LIST, HELP, invalid input and cancellation never initiate OSL downloads. Modal Settings preserves the input and selected context; closing it cannot confirm a request. Existing Settings/About access remains available without silently changing the selected file or triggering acquisition. Preserve normal parent returns, MAIN/re-entry behavior and anonymous access.
- [ ] Keep catalog content outside IndexedDB and AI context. Acquisition must not alter members, SIGs, forums, posts, mail/read-confirmation evidence, read markers, conference/OLT/NetNews records, consent or calendar settings, or repopulate restored empty boards. Ordinary session/history bookkeeping may continue. No new network requests, accounts, inference or model downloads are needed.
- [ ] Extend existing controller and Playwright coverage for valid requests, both payloads, invalid syntax, empty categories, pinned selection, HELP, cancellation, rapid repeated confirmation, initiation failure, return paths, service isolation and stale-request invalidation. In production-browser tests, capture actual download events and independently compare suggested filenames and bytes with the bundled fixtures. Observe that non-acquisition operations produce no OSL download events.
- [ ] Include production journeys with and without a handle, simulated IME confirmation while entering the acquisition/approval commands, modal Settings interaction, and a 320px viewport. Verify literal terminal output and protected-record preservation using existing snapshot facilities with automatic activity paused. Preserve existing functional, storage/import/reset, consent, composition, IME, terminal pacing/skip and service regression coverage.
- [ ] Update README usage, existing Settings/About/Details and `docs/research/pcvan-1996-1997.md`. Replace affected preview-only/no-transfer claims precisely. Record source URLs, inspection dates, era, confidence, inaccessible references and reconstruction assumptions. Keep routine output concise Japanese; historical provenance belongs on demand.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs documented `npm test` before merge; its existing configuration includes TypeScript checking and production build. Review the complete diff, check affected Markdown links and run `git diff --check`. Record actual results, failures and skipped checks. Use existing tooling without adding a framework or requiring real inference.

## Optional validation

Further dated OSL manuals or session logs could refine commands and cancellation behavior. Historical-user feedback, other browser engines and native IME observation are optional refinements, not completion gates.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. All acceptance checks are achievable before merge.
